items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: The interviewee does not respond to the mention of Hattie Burleson or confirm any personal or professional interaction; the name is only brought up by the interviewer.

ctx.x: In San Antonio. The other recordings I cut with the various artists were in Dallas, Texas.
We mentioned the Hattie. Hattie Burleson.
